top_signals.title: Hedge Funds Boost Natural Gas Short Positions to Most on Record
top_signals.summary: Hedge funds this week amassed the largest-ever short position on US natural gas on expectations that an unusually warm winter will slash demand for the furnace and power-plant fuel.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Brazil Hedge Funds Reel as Losses Reach 24% After Lula Shock
top_signals.summary: In the span of three weeks, Brazilian hedge-fund managers went from celebrating some of their biggest gains in years to nursing steep losses and issuing mea culpas to their clients.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: DOJ raises privacy concerns over potential sale of Character.AI chats
top_signals.summary: The DOJ’s Executive Office for U.S. Trustees said a consumer privacy ombudsman is needed to advise the court on how to regulate what data from Character.AI can be sold and under what terms.
